entities.name: Ferdinando d'Adda
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ferdinando d'Adda was a Roman Catholic Cardinal, bishop and diplomat. As a member of the family of the counts of Adda, he was a kinsman of Pope Innocent XI, who conferred upon him the titular abbacy of a famous abbey.
